title: AI-SDLC DodConfig
description: Definition-of-Done gate config. Lives at .ai-sdlc/dod-config.yaml. The hard-enforced exit validation run before a task is marked Done / a PR opened: build + tests must pass and changed code must carry no incomplete-work markers. Counterpart to DorConfig (entry).

evaluationMode.description: enforce blocks Done on a failed enforced check; warn only reports.

checks.description: The exit checks. build/test run a shell command that must exit 0; markers scans changed files.

outcomes.description: Advisory tier: point at a run-records JSONL to surface Level-1 outcome metrics (completion/regression/review-loops/blast-radius). Never blocks.

runRecords.description: Path (relative to project root) to the run-records JSONL.

enforced.description: If true (default), a failure blocks Done in enforce mode.
